notes: Bare printed names kept bare: CHERRY, BURGOYNE, DHONAU, ELMORE, FORD, DORMAN, APPLE; TURRILL is cut by the top edge ('...RRILL', full name from the key map); Colerain Av. and Spring Grove Av. printed with AV. All points computed from fitted block lines, not water pipes. Measured widths match the printed ones (Cherry 40, Burgoyne 30, Dhonau 31-32, Elmore 50-52, Ford 31, Spring Grove 60-64, Colerain 60, Dorman 38-40, Apple 40, Turrill 40 ft - Turrill's width is not printed here). Dorman's north line is near the top edge; Turrill (faces x 2250/2490 at the top) and Apple come in from sheet 618 and stop at Dorman (T's). Cherry/Dorman is off the paper (Dorman centre above y=0). Cherry stops at Burgoyne. Burgoyne runs off the west edge toward Colerain; its Colerain crossing (about x=-90) is off the sheet. Dhonau stops at Colerain on this sheet (Colerain's west line is continuous here; the street opposite on sheet 615 is a separate matter). Spring Grove bends at Dorman (steeper NNE leg toward sheet 616 above Dorman). Elmore runs from Colerain across Spring Grove to the Mill Creek bank; Ford leaves Elmore's south side and runs SSW parallel to Spring Grove to a dead end. Bottom left: Colerain (from the NNW) and Spring Grove (from the NNE) meet in an open junction; Colerain continues south over the 60 ft Mill Creek bridge (rails x~1600-2120 at the bottom), and Spring Grove leaves WSW along the creek onto sheet 611 (that leg measures ~70 ft between lines). Colerain/Spring Grove point = Colerain centreline x Spring Grove WSW-leg centreline (same construction as on sheet 611); alternatives: Colerain x Spring Grove NNE-leg centreline (1728,6963), the two Spring Grove legs (1820,6774). Circled numbers (55', 56', 57', 53') are grade elevations. 'BOWLING ALLEY' is a building, not a street. Scale ~6.04 px/ft.
